name: Erik Marquardt - § 108 - Am 34
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the budget of the European Union Agencies for the financial year 2023
part_text: 108. Notes Frontex’s continued efforts to strengthen its FRO, whose activities should not determine the implementation of Frontex's mandate, which is to help Members States in border protection, return of illigal migrants and secure of the Schengen area;
